title: Shadow-mode log record (one per drafted ticket during agent-assist)
description: During agent-assist every draft goes to a human, and the full quality layer runs alongside without sending anything. Each record says what the system WOULD have done and what the human actually did. harness/shadow.py turns a JSONL file of these records into the escaped-failure rates the release gates need.

synthetic.description: true only for demo records; production records must be false.

intents.description: Detected intents (harness/intents.py), not the ticket's category field.

queue.description: Human queue for a handoff, for example sales_enterprise; empty otherwise.

retrieval.description: What the retrieval node returned. null means it was not logged, which fails the logging gate.

flagged_claims.description: Claims the judge marked contradicted or unsupported (shown to the reviewer).

would_auto_send.description: What the candidate auto-send configuration would have done with this draft.

edit_severity.description: Reviewer's one-click tag: how bad the draft would have been if sent unchanged (same scale as reviews/rubric.md). Empty = not tagged.

audit.description: Present when a second reviewer re-checked this record. auditor_severity overrides edit_severity.
